newsitem.title: MEXICO: Autlan share exchange and stock split.
newsitem.headline: Autlan share exchange and stock split.

text.p: Compania Minera Autlan announced on Friday a share exchange and stock split to take effect over the following five working days.
The mining company said in a newspaper advertisement that both transactions had been approved at a shareholders assembly held September 10, 1996.
"Resolutions pertaining to the share restructuring include the (forcible) conversion of outstanding A shares into new B series shares and a stock split," the statement said.
The terms of the resolution passed provide for each outstanding A or B share to be exchanged for two B shares in common stock, with full voting and subsciption rights.
The new B shares will have coupons numbered from one to 20 and those shares only will be listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange after the exchange and split takes place.
"The shareholding structure in A and B shares restricted foreign investment more than is legally required with companies in this sector," the company said.
By law, foreign investors may not freely subscribe to A shares in Mexican listed companies.
